        "# ЯЧЕЙКА 3. Проверка данных: кэш картинок, дубликаты, «читерские» признаки, разбиение train/val/test\n",
        "_k = np.arange(32)[:, None]\n",
        "_i = np.arange(32)[None, :]\n",
        "DCT32 = np.cos(np.pi * (2 * _i + 1) * _k / 64)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def phash_bits(img, hash_size=8):\n",
        "    g = img.convert(\"L\").resize((32, 32), Image.LANCZOS)\n",
        "    a = np.asarray(g, dtype=np.float64)\n",
        "    low = (DCT32 @ a @ DCT32.T)[:hash_size, :hash_size].flatten()\n",
        "    return (low > np.median(low[1:])).astype(np.uint8)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def hamming_matrix(a, b=None):\n",
        "    a = a.astype(np.int32)\n",
        "    b = a if b is None else b.astype(np.int32)\n",
        "    return a @ (1 - b).T + (1 - a) @ b.T\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def group_duplicates(bits, thresh):\n",
        "    n = len(bits)\n",
        "    parent = list(range(n))\n",
        "\n",
        "    def find(x):\n",
        "        while parent[x] != x:\n",
        "            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]\n",
        "            x = parent[x]\n",
        "        return x\n",
        "\n",
        "    dist = hamming_matrix(bits)\n",
        "    ii, jj = np.where(np.triu(dist <= thresh, k=1))\n",
        "    for i, j in zip(ii, jj):\n",
        "        ri, rj = find(i), find(j)\n",
        "        if ri != rj:\n",
        "            parent[ri] = rj\n",
        "    return np.array([find(i) for i in range(n)])\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def color_stats(img):\n",
        "    rgb = np.asarray(img, dtype=np.float32)\n",
        "    gray = rgb.mean(axis=2)\n",
        "    lap = (4 * gray[1:-1, 1:-1] - gray[:-2, 1:-1] - gray[2:, 1:-1]\n",
        "           - gray[1:-1, :-2] - gray[1:-1, 2:])\n",
        "    b = max(1, gray.shape[0] // 10)\n",
        "    border = np.concatenate([gray[:b].ravel(), gray[-b:].ravel(), gray[:, :b].ravel(), gray[:, -b:].ravel()])\n",
        "    return {\"mean_r\": float(rgb[..., 0].mean()), \"mean_g\": float(rgb[..., 1].mean()),\n",
        "            \"mean_b\": float(rgb[..., 2].mean()), \"brightness\": float(gray.mean()),\n",
        "            \"contrast\": float(gray.std()), \"sharpness\": float(lap.var()),\n",
        "            \"border_brightness\": float(border.mean())}\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# --- 3.1 читаем все картинки один раз, приводим к IMG_SIZE и держим в памяти ---\n",
        "CACHE, HASH, STATS = {}, {}, []\n",
        "print(\"Читаю картинки (для больших снимков DIBaS это 1-3 минуты)...\")\n",
        "for n, row in enumerate(DF.itertuples(index=False)):\n",
        "    try:\n",
        "        img = Image.open(row.path)\n",
        "        img.load()\n",
        "        img = img.convert(\"RGB\")\n",
        "    except Exception as e:\n",
        "        print(\"  битый файл пропущен:\", row.path, e)\n",
        "        continue\n",
        "    w, h = img.size\n",
        "    small = img.resize((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), Image.BILINEAR)\n",
        "    CACHE[row.path] = small\n",
        "    HASH[row.path] = phash_bits(small)\n",
        "    st = color_stats(small)\n",
        "    st.update(path=row.path, width=w, height=h, file_kb=Path(row.path).stat().st_size / 1024)\n",
        "    STATS.append(st)\n",
        "    if (n + 1) % 200 == 0:\n",
        "        print(f\"  обработано {n + 1}/{len(DF)}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "DF = DF[DF[\"path\"].isin(CACHE)].reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "DF = DF.merge(pd.DataFrame(STATS), on=\"path\", how=\"left\")\n",
        "BITS = np.stack([HASH[p] for p in DF[\"path\"]])\n",
        "\n",
        "# --- 3.2 дубликаты и почти-дубликаты ---\n",
        "DF[\"group\"] = group_duplicates(BITS, DUP_THRESH)\n",
        "sizes = DF.groupby(\"group\")[\"path\"].transform(\"count\")\n",
        "print(f\"\\nГрупп дубликатов (>1 картинки): {DF.loc[sizes > 1, 'group'].nunique()}, \"\n",
        "      f\"картинок в них: {int((sizes > 1).sum())}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "mixed = DF.groupby(\"group\")[\"label\"].nunique()\n",
        "mixed_groups = list(mixed[mixed > 1].index)\n",
        "print(\"Групп с ОБОИМИ классами:\", len(mixed_groups))\n",
        "drop_paths = []\n",
        "for gid in mixed_groups:\n",
        "    g = DF[DF[\"group\"] == gid]\n",
        "    ps = g[\"path\"].tolist()\n",
        "    a = np.asarray(CACHE[ps[0]], dtype=float)\n",
        "    dmin = min(np.abs(a - np.asarray(CACHE[q], dtype=float)).mean() for q in ps[1:])\n",
        "    verdict = \"ИДЕНТИЧНЫЕ (ошибка разметки) -> удаляю копию не-E. coli\" if dmin < 8 else \"разные картинки (ложное срабатывание хэша) -> оставляю\"\n",
        "    print(f\"  группа {gid}: {[x.split('/')[-2] for x in ps]} | разница {dmin:.1f} | {verdict}\")\n",
        "    if dmin < 8:\n",
        "        drop_paths += g.loc[g[\"label\"] == 0, \"path\"].tolist()\n",
        "if drop_paths:\n",
        "    DF = DF[~DF[\"path\"].isin(drop_paths)].reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "    BITS = np.stack([HASH[p] for p in DF[\"path\"]])\n",
        "\n",
        "# --- 3.3 «читерский» тест: можно ли угадать класс по размеру/цвету/яркости/резкости? (отдельно для каждого источника) ---\n",
        "STAT_COLS = [\"width\", \"height\", \"mean_r\", \"mean_g\", \"mean_b\", \"brightness\", \"contrast\",\n",
        "             \"sharpness\", \"border_brightness\", \"file_kb\"]\n",
        "SHORTCUT_AUC = {}\n",
        "print(\"\\nAUC модели, которая видит ТОЛЬКО метаданные (0.5 = угадать нельзя, >0.75 = подозрительно):\")\n",
        "for s, g in DF.groupby(\"source\"):\n",
        "    yv = g[\"label\"].values\n",
        "    if yv.sum() < 5 or (1 - yv).sum() < 5:\n",
        "        print(\"  \", s, \": слишком мало примеров одного из классов, пропуск\")\n",
        "        continue\n",
        "    try:\n",
        "        cv = StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)\n",
        "        pr = cross_val_predict(GradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=SEED), g[STAT_COLS].values, yv,\n",
        "                               groups=g[\"group\"].values, cv=cv, method=\"predict_proba\")[:, 1]\n",
        "        SHORTCUT_AUC[s] = float(roc_auc_score(yv, pr))\n",
        "        print(f\"   {s}: AUC = {SHORTCUT_AUC[s]:.3f}\")\n",
        "    except Exception as e:\n",
        "        print(\"  \", s, \": не удалось посчитать:\", e)\n",
        "\n",
        "# --- 3.4 разбиение 60/20/20 по ГРУППАМ дубликатов, стратификация по источник+вид ---\n",
        "strat = (DF[\"source\"] + \"/\" + DF[\"species\"]).astype(\"category\").cat.codes.values\n",
        "groups = DF[\"group\"].values\n",
        "DF[\"split\"] = \"train\"\n",
        "s1 = StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)\n",
        "rest_idx, test_idx = next(s1.split(DF, strat, groups))\n",
        "s2 = StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=4, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)\n",
        "_, val_rel = next(s2.split(DF.iloc[rest_idx], strat[rest_idx], groups[rest_idx]))\n",
        "DF.loc[test_idx, \"split\"] = \"test\"\n",
        "DF.loc[rest_idx[val_rel], \"split\"] = \"val\"\n",
        "assert (DF.groupby(\"group\")[\"split\"].nunique() == 1).all(), \"дубликат попал в разные части!\"\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nРазбиение (строки - источник и класс):\")\n",
        "print(pd.crosstab([DF[\"source\"], DF[\"label_name\"]], DF[\"split\"], margins=True))"

        "# ЯЧЕЙКА 4. Функции: датасет, модель, обучение, калибровка, оценка (только определения, ничего не запускает)\n",
        "MEAN, STD = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]\n",
        "\n",
        "train_tfm = T.Compose([\n",
        "    T.RandomResizedCrop(IMG_SIZE, scale=(0.6, 1.0), ratio=(0.85, 1.18)),\n",
        "    T.RandomHorizontalFlip(), T.RandomVerticalFlip(),\n",
        "    T.RandomApply([T.RandomRotation(90)], p=0.5),\n",
        "    T.ColorJitter(brightness=0.25, contrast=0.25, saturation=0.15, hue=0.02),\n",
        "    T.RandomGrayscale(p=0.1),\n",
        "    T.ToTensor(), T.Normalize(MEAN, STD)])\n",
        "eval_tfm = T.Compose([T.ToTensor(), T.Normalize(MEAN, STD)])\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "class CachedDS(Dataset):\n",
        "    def __init__(self, df, tfm):\n",
        "        self.paths = df[\"path\"].tolist()\n",
        "        self.y = df[\"label\"].astype(int).tolist()\n",
        "        self.tfm = tfm\n",
        "\n",
        "    def __len__(self):\n",
        "        return len(self.paths)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def __getitem__(self, i):\n",
        "        return self.tfm(CACHE[self.paths[i]]), self.y[i]\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def build_model():\n",
        "    weights = models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT if USE_PRETRAINED else None\n",
        "    m = models.resnet18(weights=weights)\n",
        "    m.fc = nn.Linear(m.fc.in_features, 2)\n",
        "    return m.to(DEVICE)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "@torch.no_grad()\n",
        "def get_logits(model, df, batch_size=32):\n",
        "    model.eval()\n",
        "    dl = DataLoader(CachedDS(df, eval_tfm), batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)\n",
        "    return torch.cat([model(x.to(DEVICE)).cpu() for x, _ in dl]).numpy()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def softmax_T(logits, temperature=1.0):\n",
        "    z = logits / temperature\n",
        "    z = z - z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n",
        "    e = np.exp(z)\n",
        "    return e / e.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def fit_temperature(logits, y):\n",
        "    best_t, best_nll = 1.0, 1e9\n",
        "    for t in np.arange(0.5, 5.01, 0.05):\n",
        "        p = softmax_T(logits, t)[np.arange(len(y)), y]\n",
        "        nll = float(-np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-8, 1)).mean())\n",
        "        if nll < best_nll:\n",
        "            best_t, best_nll = float(t), nll\n",
        "    return best_t\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def choose_tau(p_ecoli, y, target_acc=0.95, min_coverage=0.80, min_tau=0.70, default=0.80):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Порог Uncertain: минимальный tau (не меньше min_tau), при котором точность на «принятых» >= target_acc\n",
        "    и принято не менее min_coverage картинок. Иначе default.\"\"\"\n",
        "    conf = np.maximum(p_ecoli, 1 - p_ecoli)\n",
        "    pred = (p_ecoli >= 0.5).astype(int)\n",
        "    for tau in np.arange(min_tau, 0.995, 0.005):\n",
        "        keep = conf >= tau\n",
        "        if keep.mean() < min_coverage:\n",
        "            break\n",
        "        if (pred[keep] == y[keep]).mean() >= target_acc:\n",
        "            return float(round(tau, 3))\n",
        "    return default\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def apply_rule(p_ecoli, tau):\n",
        "    p_ecoli = np.asarray(p_ecoli)\n",
        "    pred = (p_ecoli >= 0.5).astype(int)\n",
        "    conf = np.maximum(p_ecoli, 1 - p_ecoli)\n",
        "    return pred, conf, conf < tau\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def train_model(train_df, val_df, epochs_head=6, epochs_ft=6, lr_head=1e-3, lr_ft=3e-5,\n",
        "                batch_size=16, verbose=True):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Сначала учим только последний слой (epochs_head эпох), потом всю сеть с малым lr (epochs_ft эпох).\n",
        "    Лучшая эпоха выбирается по val (среднее AUC и balanced accuracy). Потом на val подбираются temperature и tau.\"\"\"\n",
        "    set_seed(SEED)\n",
        "    model = build_model()\n",
        "    dl = DataLoader(CachedDS(train_df, train_tfm), batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=2,\n",
        "                    drop_last=len(train_df) >= 2 * batch_size)\n",
        "    counts = train_df[\"label\"].value_counts().reindex([0, 1]).fillna(1).values.astype(float)\n",
        "    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(\n",
        "        weight=torch.tensor(len(train_df) / (2 * counts), dtype=torch.float32, device=DEVICE))\n",
        "\n",
        "    def set_backbone_trainable(flag):\n",
        "        for pname, prm in model.named_parameters():\n",
        "            prm.requires_grad = bool(flag) or pname.startswith(\"fc.\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    set_backbone_trainable(False)\n",
        "    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.fc.parameters(), lr=lr_head, weight_decay=1e-4)\n",
        "    sched = None\n",
        "    yv = val_df[\"label\"].values.astype(int)\n",
        "    best_score, best_auc, best_state, history = -1.0, float('nan'), None, []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for epoch in range(epochs_head + epochs_ft):\n",
        "        frozen = epoch < epochs_head\n",
        "        if epoch == epochs_head and epochs_ft > 0:\n",
        "            set_backbone_trainable(True)\n",
        "            opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr_ft, weight_decay=1e-4)\n",
        "            sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(opt, T_max=epochs_ft)\n",
        "        model.train()\n",
        "        if frozen:  # пока backbone заморожен, статистики BatchNorm тоже не трогаем\n",
        "            for mod in model.modules():\n",
        "                if isinstance(mod, nn.BatchNorm2d):\n",
        "                    mod.eval()\n",
        "        total, seen = 0.0, 0\n",
        "        for x, y in dl:\n",
        "            x, y = x.to(DEVICE), y.to(DEVICE)\n",
        "            opt.zero_grad()\n",
        "            loss = criterion(model(x), y)\n",
        "            loss.backward()\n",
        "            opt.step()\n",
        "            total += loss.item() * len(y)\n",
        "            seen += len(y)\n",
        "        if sched is not None:\n",
        "            sched.step()\n",
        "        pv = softmax_T(get_logits(model, val_df))[:, 1]\n",
        "        auc = roc_auc_score(yv, pv) if len(set(yv)) > 1 else float(\"nan\")\n",
        "        bacc = balanced_accuracy_score(yv, (pv >= 0.5).astype(int))\n",
        "        score = ((auc if not np.isnan(auc) else bacc) + bacc) / 2  # и ранжирование, и порог 0.5 должны быть хороши\n",
        "        history.append({\"epoch\": epoch + 1, \"phase\": \"head\" if frozen else \"fine-tune\",\n",
        "                        \"train_loss\": round(total / max(seen, 1), 4),\n",

        "        if score >= best_score:\n",
        "            best_score, best_auc = score, auc\n",
        "            best_state = {k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}\n",
        "\n",
        "    model.load_state_dict(best_state)\n",
        "    logits = get_logits(model, val_df)\n",
        "    temp = fit_temperature(logits, yv)\n",
        "    pv = softmax_T(logits, temp)[:, 1]\n",
        "    tau = choose_tau(pv, yv)\n",
        "    return {\"model\": model, \"T\": temp, \"tau\": tau, \"val_score\": float(best_score), \"val_auc\": float(best_auc),\n",
        "            \"history\": pd.DataFrame(history)}\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def bootstrap_ci(y, pred, fn, n=1000, seed=0):\n",
        "    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n",
        "    vals = []\n",
        "    for _ in range(n):\n",
        "        idx = rng.integers(0, len(y), len(y))\n",
        "        if len(set(y[idx])) < 2:\n",
        "            continue\n",
        "        vals.append(fn(y[idx], pred[idx]))\n",
        "    return (round(float(np.percentile(vals, 2.5)), 2), round(float(np.percentile(vals, 97.5)), 2)) if vals else (None, None)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def contact_sheet(paths, captions, thumb=200, cols=4):\n",
        "    rows = (len(paths) + cols - 1) // cols\n",
        "    sheet = Image.new(\"RGB\", (cols * thumb, rows * (thumb + 34)), \"white\")\n",

        "    for i, (p, c) in enumerate(zip(paths, captions)):\n",

        "        sheet.paste(CACHE[p].resize((thumb, thumb)), (x, y))\n",
        "        draw.text((x + 3, y + thumb + 2), c[:34], fill=\"black\")\n",
        "        draw.text((x + 3, y + thumb + 16), c[34:68], fill=\"black\")\n",
        "    return sheet\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "RESULTS = {}\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def evaluate(bundle, df, title, n_show=8):\n",
        "    df = df.copy().reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "    y = df[\"label\"].values.astype(int)\n",
        "    p = softmax_T(get_logits(bundle[\"model\"], df), bundle[\"T\"])[:, 1]\n",
        "    pred, conf, unc = apply_rule(p, bundle[\"tau\"])\n",
        "    df[\"p_ecoli\"], df[\"pred\"], df[\"confidence\"], df[\"uncertain\"] = p, pred, conf, unc\n",
        "    keep = ~unc\n",
        "    two = len(set(y)) > 1\n",
        "    m = {\n",
        "        \"n\": len(df), \"n_ecoli\": int(y.sum()),\n",
        "        \"accuracy\": accuracy_score(y, pred),\n",
        "        \"balanced_acc\": balanced_accuracy_score(y, pred),\n",
        "        \"precision_ecoli\": precision_score(y, pred, zero_division=0),\n",
        "        \"recall_ecoli\": recall_score(y, pred, zero_division=0),\n",
        "        \"f1_ecoli\": f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0),\n",
        "        \"roc_auc\": roc_auc_score(y, p) if two else float(\"nan\"),\n",
        "        \"pr_auc\": average_precision_score(y, p) if two else float(\"nan\"),\n",
        "        \"recall_ci95\": bootstrap_ci(y, pred, lambda a, b: recall_score(a, b, zero_division=0)),\n",
        "        \"balanced_acc_ci95\": bootstrap_ci(y, pred, balanced_accuracy_score),\n",
        "        \"tau\": bundle[\"tau\"], \"coverage\": float(keep.mean()),\n",
        "        \"ecoli_uncertain\": int((unc & (y == 1)).sum()),\n",
        "        \"acc_on_decided\": float(accuracy_score(y[keep], pred[keep])) if keep.any() else float(\"nan\"),\n",
        "        \"recall_on_decided\": float(recall_score(y[keep], pred[keep], zero_division=0)) if keep.any() else float(\"nan\"),\n",
        "        \"precision_on_decided\": float(precision_score(y[keep], pred[keep], zero_division=0)) if keep.any() else float(\"nan\"),\n",
        "    }\n",
        "    RESULTS[title] = m\n",
        "    print(f\"\\n===== {title}: {m['n']} картинок, из них E. coli: {m['n_ecoli']} =====\")\n",
        "    print(f\"Accuracy {m['accuracy']:.3f} | Balanced acc {m['balanced_acc']:.3f} {m['balanced_acc_ci95']} | ROC-AUC {m['roc_auc']:.3f} | PR-AUC {m['pr_auc']:.3f}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"E. coli: recall {m['recall_ecoli']:.3f} {m['recall_ci95']} | precision {m['precision_ecoli']:.3f} | F1 {m['f1_ecoli']:.3f}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"С правилом Uncertain (tau={m['tau']}): принято {m['coverage']:.0%}, E. coli в Uncertain: {m['ecoli_uncertain']}, \"\n",
        "          f\"точность на принятых {m['acc_on_decided']:.3f}, recall на принятых {m['recall_on_decided']:.3f}\")\n",
        "    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0, 1])\n",
        "    print(pd.DataFrame(cm, index=[\"истина: Not E. coli\", \"истина: E. coli\"],\n",
        "                       columns=[\"предсказано: Not E. coli\", \"предсказано: E. coli\"]))\n",
        "    df[\"correct\"] = (df[\"pred\"] == df[\"label\"]).astype(int)\n",
        "    print(\"\\nПо видам:\")\n",
        "    print(df.groupby(\"species\").agg(n=(\"path\", \"count\"), accuracy=(\"correct\", \"mean\"),\n",
        "                                    mean_p_ecoli=(\"p_ecoli\", \"mean\"), share_uncertain=(\"uncertain\", \"mean\")).round(2))\n",
        "    wrong = df[df[\"correct\"] == 0].sort_values(\"confidence\", ascending=False).head(n_show)\n",

        "                              [f\"ERR true={r.label} p={r.p_ecoli:.2f} {r.species}\" for r in wrong.itertuples()]))\n",
        "    return df\n",

        "# ЯЧЕЙКА 8. Итоговая программа: картинка -> E. coli / Not E. coli / Uncertain + интерфейс\n",
        "@torch.no_grad()\n",
        "def predict_image(img, bundle=None):\n",
        "    bundle = bundle or BUNDLE\n",
        "    img = img.convert(\"RGB\")\n",
        "    if min(img.size) < 96:\n",
        "        return {\"prediction\": \"Uncertain\", \"confidence\": None, \"status\": \"Uncertain\",\n",
        "                \"message\": \"Изображение слишком маленькое (меньше 96 px по короткой стороне).\"}\n",
        "    x = eval_tfm(img.resize((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), Image.BILINEAR)).unsqueeze(0).to(DEVICE)\n",
        "    bundle[\"model\"].eval()\n",
        "    p = float(softmax_T(bundle[\"model\"](x).cpu().numpy(), bundle[\"T\"])[0, 1])\n",
        "    conf = max(p, 1 - p)\n",
        "    if conf < bundle[\"tau\"]:\n",
        "        return {\"prediction\": \"Uncertain\", \"confidence\": conf, \"status\": \"Uncertain\",\n",
        "                \"message\": (f\"Модель не уверена (уверенность {conf:.0%} ниже порога {bundle['tau']:.0%}). \"\n",
        "                            \"Возможно, изображение отличается от обучающих (увеличение, окраска, фон) - нужна проверка человеком.\")}\n",
        "    return {\"prediction\": \"E. coli\" if p >= 0.5 else \"Not E. coli\", \"confidence\": conf, \"status\": \"Result\",\n",
        "            \"message\": \"Исследовательский прототип, не диагностический инструмент.\"}\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# демонстрация на случайных картинках из test\n",
        "demo_rows = DF[DF[\"split\"] == \"test\"].sample(8, random_state=SEED)\n",
        "caps, ps = [], []\n",
        "for r in demo_rows.itertuples():\n",
        "    out = predict_image(Image.open(r.path))\n",
        "    conf = \"-\" if out[\"confidence\"] is None else f\"{out['confidence']:.0%}\"\n",
        "    caps.append(f\"{out['prediction']} {conf} | истина: {r.label_name}\")\n",
        "    ps.append(r.path)\n",
        "    print(f\"{r.species:38s} истина: {r.label_name:12s} -> {out['prediction']:12s} ({conf})\")\n",
        "display(contact_sheet(ps, caps))\n",
        "\n",
        "# интерфейс (Gradio): в Colab появится публичная ссылка\n",
        "import gradio as gr\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def ui_predict(image):\n",
        "    if image is None:\n",
        "        return \"-\", \"-\", \"-\", \"Загрузите изображение.\"\n",
        "    out = predict_image(image)\n",
        "    conf = \"-\" if out[\"confidence\"] is None else f\"{out['confidence']:.0%}\"\n",
        "    return out[\"prediction\"], conf, out[\"status\"], out[\"message\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "demo = gr.Interface(\n",
        "    fn=ui_predict,\n",
        "    inputs=gr.Image(type=\"pil\", label=\"Микроскопическое изображение бактерий\"),\n",
        "    outputs=[gr.Textbox(label=\"Prediction\"), gr.Textbox(label=\"Confidence\"),\n",
        "             gr.Textbox(label=\"Status (Result / Uncertain)\"), gr.Textbox(label=\"Comment\")],\n",
        "    title=\"E. coli / Not E. coli / Uncertain - исследовательский прототип\",\n",
        "    description=\"Загрузите изображение (оптическая микроскопия). Учебный прототип, не диагностическая система.\")\n",
        "demo.launch(share=True)"

              "    async function download(id, filename, size) {\n",
              "      if (!google.colab.kernel.accessAllowed) {\n",
              "        return;\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const div = document.createElement('div');\n",
              "      const label = document.createElement('label');\n",
              "      label.textContent = `Downloading \"${filename}\": `;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(label);\n",
              "      const progress = document.createElement('progress');\n",
              "      progress.max = size;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(progress);\n",
              "      document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
              "\n",
              "      const buffers = [];\n",
              "      let downloaded = 0;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const channel = await google.colab.kernel.comms.open(id);\n",
              "      // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "      channel.send({})\n",
              "\n",
              "      for await (const message of channel.messages) {\n",
              "        // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "        channel.send({})\n",
              "        if (message.buffers) {\n",
              "          for (const buffer of message.buffers) {\n",
              "            buffers.push(buffer);\n",
              "            downloaded += buffer.byteLength;\n",
              "            progress.value = downloaded;\n",
              "          }\n",
              "        }\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const blob = new Blob(buffers, {type: 'application/binary'});\n",
              "      const a = document.createElement('a');\n",
              "      a.href = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n",
              "      a.download = filename;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(a);\n",
              "      a.click();\n",
              "      div.remove();\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  "
            ]

              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * @fileoverview Helpers for google.colab Python module.\n",
              " */\n",
              "(function(scope) {\n",
              "function span(text, styleAttributes = {}) {\n",
              "  const element = document.createElement('span');\n",
              "  element.textContent = text;\n",
              "  for (const key of Object.keys(styleAttributes)) {\n",
              "    element.style[key] = styleAttributes[key];\n",
              "  }\n",
              "  return element;\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// Max number of bytes which will be uploaded at a time.\n",
              "const MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 100 * 1024;\n",
              "\n",
              "function _uploadFiles(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const steps = uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId);\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  // Cache steps on the outputElement to make it available for the next call\n",
              "  // to uploadFilesContinue from Python.\n",
              "  outputElement.steps = steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  return _uploadFilesContinue(outputId);\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// This is roughly an async generator (not supported in the browser yet),\n",
              "// where there are multiple asynchronous steps and the Python side is going\n",
              "// to poll for completion of each step.\n",
              "// This uses a Promise to block the python side on completion of each step,\n",
              "// then passes the result of the previous step as the input to the next step.\n",
              "function _uploadFilesContinue(outputId) {\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  const steps = outputElement.steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const next = steps.next(outputElement.lastPromiseValue);\n",
              "  return Promise.resolve(next.value.promise).then((value) => {\n",
              "    // Cache the last promise value to make it available to the next\n",
              "    // step of the generator.\n",
              "    outputElement.lastPromiseValue = value;\n",
              "    return next.value.response;\n",
              "  });\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * Generator function which is called between each async step of the upload\n",
              " * process.\n",
              " * @param {string} inputId Element ID of the input file picker element.\n",
              " * @param {string} outputId Element ID of the output display.\n",
              " * @return {!Iterable<!Object>} Iterable of next steps.\n",
              " */\n",
              "function* uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const inputElement = document.getElementById(inputId);\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = false;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  outputElement.innerHTML = '';\n",
              "\n",
              "  const pickedPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    inputElement.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n",
              "      resolve(e.target.files);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  const cancel = document.createElement('button');\n",
              "  inputElement.parentElement.appendChild(cancel);\n",
              "  cancel.textContent = 'Cancel upload';\n",
              "  const cancelPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    cancel.onclick = () => {\n",
              "      resolve(null);\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Wait for the user to pick the files.\n",
              "  const files = yield {\n",
              "    promise: Promise.race([pickedPromise, cancelPromise]),\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'starting',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "\n",
              "  cancel.remove();\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Disable the input element since further picks are not allowed.\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = true;\n",
              "\n",
              "  if (!files) {\n",
              "    return {\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'complete',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  for (const file of files) {\n",
              "    const li = document.createElement('li');\n",
              "    li.append(span(file.name, {fontWeight: 'bold'}));\n",
              "    li.append(span(\n",
              "        `(${file.type || 'n/a'}) - ${file.size} bytes, ` +\n",
              "        `last modified: ${\n",
              "            file.lastModifiedDate ? file.lastModifiedDate.toLocaleDateString() :\n",
              "                                    'n/a'} - `));\n",
              "    const percent = span('0% done');\n",
              "    li.appendChild(percent);\n",
              "\n",
              "    outputElement.appendChild(li);\n",
              "\n",
              "    const fileDataPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "      const reader = new FileReader();\n",
              "      reader.onload = (e) => {\n",
              "        resolve(e.target.result);\n",
              "      };\n",
              "      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "    // Wait for the data to be ready.\n",
              "    let fileData = yield {\n",
              "      promise: fileDataPromise,\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'continue',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "\n",
              "    // Use a chunked sending to avoid message size limits. See b/62115660.\n",
              "    let position = 0;\n",
              "    do {\n",
              "      const length = Math.min(fileData.byteLength - position, MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE);\n",
              "      const chunk = new Uint8Array(fileData, position, length);\n",
              "      position += length;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const base64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk));\n",
              "      yield {\n",
              "        response: {\n",
              "          action: 'append',\n",
              "          file: file.name,\n",
              "          data: base64,\n",
              "        },\n",
              "      };\n",
              "\n",
              "      let percentDone = fileData.byteLength === 0 ?\n",
              "          100 :\n",
              "          Math.round((position / fileData.byteLength) * 100);\n",
              "      percent.textContent = `${percentDone}% done`;\n",
              "\n",
              "    } while (position < fileData.byteLength);\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  // All done.\n",
              "  yield {\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'complete',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "scope.google = scope.google || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab = scope.google.colab || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab._files = {\n",
              "  _uploadFiles,\n",
              "  _uploadFilesContinue,\n",
              "};\n",
              "})(self);\n",
              "</script> "

              "      if (!google.colab.kernel.accessAllowed) {\n",
              "        return;\n",
